sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Many young people in Lampung believe fully funded scholarships are out of reach, simply because they have never met anyone who received one. At the same time, scholarship alumni want to give back but lack a structured way to do it.

Mata Garuda Lampung connects the two.

items.title: Scholarship information sessions
items.description: Free talks and clinics on LPDP and other scholarships, from documents to interviews.

items.title: Community service
items.description: Alumni-led programs in education and community development across Lampung.

items.title: Alumni collaboration
items.description: A network for awardees and alumni to work on regional development ideas together.

sections.body: Each year more applicants from Lampung reach the interview stage, and many come back to help the next cohort.
